title: Services / Garage and nix cache
description: The S3 store behind Attic and the nix cache: cluster quorum, request rate, errors and latency per S3 call, block repair, the requests the Gateways pass to the cache and the clients behind them.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

links.title: Gateway requests to the cache
links.tooltip: Requests to atticd and Garage with their clients

list.name: Argo CD syncs
list.expr: (sum by (name, phase) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false",name!~".+-mr-[0-9]+"}[2m])) > 0 unless on (name) sum by (name) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false"}[1h])) > 6) and on () vector($syncs) > 0

list.name: Host rebuilds
list.expr: (max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds) unless max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds offset 15m)) and on () vector($rebuilds) > 0

list.name: syncs
list.label: Argo CD syncs
list.description: Marks each Argo CD sync on the time series.

list.name: rebuilds
list.label: Host rebuilds
list.description: Marks each NixOS rebuild on the time series.

panels.description: healthy: every storage node answers. degraded: a node is down, every partition keeps quorum and nix pulls work. unavailable: some partitions lost quorum, so reads and writes fail.
Storage nodes in the layout that this node does not reach. With three replicas one node down keeps quorum.
Share of partitions whose replicas reach write quorum. Below 100 % some writes fail, and so do nix pushes.
Free space on this node's data disk.
Blocks whose last resync failed, retried after 1 to 64 min. A layout node that never connects fails every deletion and offload.
Blocks waiting for repair or replication.
Time until the resync queue drains at its slope over the last 30 min.
When the resync queue drains at its slope over the last 30 min.

panels.title: Requests by call
panels.description: S3 calls per second by API endpoint. GetObject carries nix cache downloads.

panels.title: Errors by call
panels.description: Failed S3 calls per second by endpoint and status.

panels.title: Latency p95 by call
panels.description: 95th percentile duration per S3 endpoint.

panels.title: Block throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second read from and written to the data disk.

panels.title: RPC errors and timeouts
panels.description: Calls to other Garage nodes that failed or timed out, by endpoint and peer. A down node shows up here first. Each point averages a 72nd of the time range, such as 5 minutes on 6 hours.

panels.title: Background queues
panels.description: Table GC, merkle updates, inserts and block resync waiting. Queues that only grow mean the node falls behind.

panels.title: Resync throughput and errors
panels.description: Blocks resynced per minute and the failures among them. Failures level with the total mean that no block gets through. Each point averages a 72nd of the time range, such as 5 minutes on 6 hours.

panels.title: Peer connection by node
panels.description: Share of time this node held a connection to each layout node, and the longest disconnect within each point. A node never seen has no disconnected time. Each point averages a 72nd of the time range, such as 5 minutes on 6 hours.

panels.title: Ping timeouts by peer
panels.description: Pings unanswered for 10 s, from the Garage log. Five in a row drop the connection, and writes to that peer fail until it returns. Each point averages a 72nd of the time range, such as 5 minutes on 6 hours.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=garage k8s.container.name:=garage "Error pinging" | extract "Error pinging <peer>: " | stats by (peer) count() timeouts

panels.title: Write quorum over time
panels.description: Share of partitions with write quorum, and whether the cluster answers at all. Red marks time below 100 %.

panels.title: Cache uploads by status
panels.description: Uploads to atticd per interval by final status. 408 and 504 after 5 min: Envoy's idle timeout cut a stalled upload. 503: atticd was down.

targets.expr: _stream:{service.name="hubble"} backend.service:="atticd/atticd" url.path:="/_api/v1/upload-path" edge.event:=response | stats by (http.response.status_code) count() uploads

panels.title: Cache connections cut mid-request
panels.description: Connections from the vmk3s Envoy closed with a request in flight, by backend and side. Each one that atticd closes cuts a transfer.

panels.title: Restarts and OOM kills
panels.description: Container restarts of atticd, Garage and the vmk3s Envoy, with OOM kills among them. A restart cuts every transfer in flight.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name) (increase(k8s_container_restarts{k8s_namespace_name=~"atticd|garage" or k8s_pod_name=~"cilium-envoy-.+", k8s_node_name="vmk3s"}[$__interval])) > 0
sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_oom_events_total{namespace=~"atticd|garage" or pod=~"cilium-envoy-.+", node="vmk3s"}[$__interval])) > 0

panels.title: Memory of limit
panels.description: Working set per container as a share of its limit. At 100 % the kernel kills the container.

targets.expr: max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{k8s_namespace_name=~"atticd|garage" or k8s_pod_name=~"cilium-envoy-.+", k8s_node_name="vmk3s"}) / max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_memory_limit_bytes{k8s_namespace_name=~"atticd|garage" or k8s_pod_name=~"cilium-envoy-.+", k8s_node_name="vmk3s"})

panels.title: Cache clients
panels.description: Clients of atticd and of the Garage S3 endpoint over the selected range, busiest first. A nix client fetching a large closure shows up here with thousands of requests. Select a client for all its requests.

targets.expr: _stream:{service.name="hubble"} edge.event:=response backend.service:in("atticd/atticd", "garage/garage") | stats by (client.name, client.network, geo.country_name, backend.service) count() requests, count() if (url.path:~"^/nar/") nars, count() if (http.response.status_code:>=400) errors, max(_time) last | math round(last / 1000000) as last | sort by (requests desc) | limit 100

panels.title: Garage readers by namespace
panels.description: Requests per second to the Garage S3 endpoint by calling namespace, from Hubble's counters. atticd reads chunks here for every NAR it serves, so its line follows the cache load.

panels.title: atticd
panels.description: atticd log lines, newest first.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=atticd k8s.container.name:=atticd | copy severity_text as level

panels.title: Garage warnings
panels.description: Garage lines at warning and above, newest first.

targets.expr: k8s.namespace.name:=garage k8s.container.name:=garage severity_number:>=13 | copy severity_text as level
